title: What Plants Need to Grow
seo_title: Grade 2 What Plants Need Worksheets: Sunlight, Water and Fair Tests
standard_text: Plan and conduct an investigation to determine if plants need sunlight and water to grow.
meta_desc: Free grade 2 science worksheets on what plants need (NGSS 2-LS2-1): sunlight and water, fair tests and reading plant growth data. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Test it fairly: change only one thing.
body_html:
How to think about it

Plants need sunlight and water to grow.

  • No light: pale and weak.
  • No water: wilted.
  • Test fairly: change only one thing.
Example

A plant gets water but no light. What happens?

Plants need light.

Answer: It grows pale and weak.

Example

Test: do plants need water? What do you change?

Change one thing.

Answer: only the water

Common mistakes

  • Thinking plants get food from the soil. They make food with sunlight.
  • Thinking more water is always better.
  • Changing two things at once, so the test is not fair.

faq.q: What do plants need to grow?
faq.a: Sunlight, water, air and space. This unit tests sunlight and water.

faq.q: How do you test if plants need light?
faq.a: Use two plants that are the same. Give both the same water. Put one in the sun and one in the dark.
No. Plants make their own food in their leaves using sunlight, water and air.

c: They will all grow the same.
items.e: Plants need both sunlight and water.

items.q: Where do plants make their food?
items.e: Leaves use light to make food.

items.e: Plants need water.

items.q: Nora keeps a plant in the sun with no water for 2 weeks. What most likely happens?
c: It grew pale, thin and weak.
items.e: Sunlight + water = healthy. No light = pale and weak. No water = wilted.
